title: Luke 15:1-10
subtitle: Thursday of the 31st Week in Ordinary Time · Phil 3:3-8a; Ps 105; Lk 15:1-10
text: When the Pharisees grumble that Jesus welcomes sinners, he tells of a shepherd who leaves the ninety-nine to find one lost sheep, and a woman who lights a lamp and sweeps the house for one lost coin. God does not wait for the lost to find their own way home. He goes looking, and heaven rejoices over every one who repents.
imageAlt: A woman in a white head covering and a striped green, red and yellow robe kneels with her face to the stone floor of a dim room, searching beside a woven basket and a small lamp for her lost coin.
